visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a modern indoor kitchen with dark cabinets and warm lighting. A man with short black hair and a white T-shirt stands in the center, speaking animatedly while gesturing with his hands to the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a bright outdoor park under clear sunlight. The man is running towards the camera on a paved path, surrounded by green lawns and large trees. He appears slightly sweaty and is wearing blue shorts with his white shirt. (3) He leans towards the camera in the park, holding a small blue and white spray bottle with brand labeling. He demonstrates spraying the product on his shirt collar, back, and socks, with blue mist graphic effects indicating cooling. (4) A close-up shows a brown motorcycle helmet on a surface. A hand sprays the product inside the lining, accompanied by more cooling mist visual effects and variety text overlays. (5) Back indoors, the man is in the kitchen again, giving a thumbs up. He smells his shirt and smiles as sparkle graphics appear around him. He then eats a meal of meat and broccoli from a pan with a fork. (6) Finally, the man sits on a couch in a living room, holding the spray bottle and speaking to the camera. Large text overlays list pricing and retail locations like Poya and Watsons.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-arousal male speech in Mandarin, delivered at a fast rate with energetic, friendly prosody. An upbeat, electronic pop BGM with a steady four-on-the-floor beat starts immediately, providing a vibrant energy background. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition to an outdoor park scene. The male voice continues, sounding slightly more breathless but still clear. Faint ambient natural noise from the outdoor setting is barely audible beneath the music. (3) Multiple high-frequency 'hissing' sound effects are heard as the man demonstrates spraying the product. These intentional SFX are crisp and timed with visual mist effects, layered clearly over the BGM. (4) A low-arousal 'ugh' vocalization indicates the smell of sweat, followed by a short strategic pause. Then, a bright, synthesized 'sparkling ding' SFX rings out, signaling the success of the cooling spray. (5) Subtle percussive clinking sounds from a fork hitting a plate are audible during the eating segment. The BGM remains constant in tempo and volume, maintaining the high-energy flow. (6) The vocal delivery shifts to a professional, authoritative yet friendly promotional tone for the outro. The electronic BGM persists through the final frames where retail prices and locations are discussed.
